hero.title: File:HMS Nabob.jpg
hero.artist: Hudson, F A (Lt) Royal Navy official photographer
hero.credit: This photograph A 25368 comes from the collections of the Imperial War Museums(collection no. 4700-01)
hero.description: IWM caption : The damaged HMS NABOB proceeding homewards under her own steam, her stern low down in the water. She was hit by a torpedo during an operation in northern waters. Despite her damaged condition, NABOB turned homeward with a skeleton crew and reached her base after sailing 1070 miles at a steady ten knots.
categories: Black and white photographs of Canada
Collections of the Imperial War Museum

gallery.title: File:HMS Berwick waves.jpg
gallery.artist: Davies, F A (Lt), Royal Navy official photographer
gallery.description: IWM caption : One of the escort cruisers, HMS BERWICK, "taking it green" as water crashes over her bows off the Norwegian coast. FURTHER INFORMATION: On the 22 - 24 August and on the 29 August Fleet Air Arm aircraft of the Home Fleet carried out a series of raids on targets in Norway and particularly on the German battleship TIRPITZ in her hideout in the Alten Fjord on 29 August.
categories: Black and white photographs of ships
Photographs from the Imperial War Museum
